notes: Incident postmortem with times and counts.

expected.title: Checkout outage caused by expired TLS certificate
expected.summary: On 7 January the checkout service failed about 30% of requests for roughly two and a half hours because a TLS certificate on the payments gateway had expired. About 1,900 orders failed. The certificate and the renewal job have been fixed and expiry monitoring will be added.
key_points: Errors on about 30% of checkout requests, 14:10 to 16:45 UTC on 7 January
Cause: expired TLS certificate on the internal payments gateway
Renewal job had been failing silently since December
About 1,900 orders failed; customers were not charged
Diagnosis took 95 minutes because the alert pointed at the wrong service
Certificate renewed, renewal job fixed, expiry monitoring to be added
